Name: Orpah
Summary: Orpah, a Moabitess, married Chilion, son of Naomi; after her husband's death she kissed Naomi farewell and returned to her own people, unlike Ruth.
KeyStory: Orpah, Naomi's daughter-in-law, wept with Ruth at the parting, but when Naomi urged her to return, Orpah kissed her mother-in-law and went back to Moab.
RelatedPeople: Naomi; Ruth; Chilion, Son of Elimelech
LifeLesson: Orpah's farewell was not faithlessness — she did what Naomi herself urged.
